title: Standard Serial Dilution Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather equipment and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect an Opentrons OT‑2 robot (Run App version 3.19.0 or later), a P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette, a 96‑Tip Rack 300 µL (Slot 1), 300 µL tips, and Corning 96‑Well Plate 360 µL Flat (Slots 2‑up to 11).

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑Tip Rack 300 µL in Slot 1 and load the required number of Corning 96‑Well Plates into Slots 2 through the last slot needed (up to Slot 11) according to the deck map.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, upload the custom labware definition file for the reservoir and the 96‑Well Plate.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the generated protocol package (containing the script and labware definitions) into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Calibrate robot components
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the deck, the 96‑Tip Rack, and the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette according to the provided support articles.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the customizations field, specify the Number of Columns (how many columns per plate will contain the dilution series) and the Number of Plates (how many plates will be processed).

steps.title: Perform 10‑fold serial dilution
steps.instruction: For each plate, execute the following for each column up to the specified number:

substeps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL of the starting solution into the first column of the plate.
Mix the 100 µL by aspirating and dispensing 12 times with the P300 pipette.
Transfer 20 µL from the current column to the next column.
Repeat the mix‑12‑times and 20 µL transfer steps for each subsequent column until the specified number of columns is reached.
After completing a plate, discard the tip and use a fresh tip for the next plate.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the automated serial dilution on the robot.
